import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.applications import EfficientNetB0
from tensorflow.keras.applications.efficientnet import preprocess_input
from tensorflow.keras.models import Model

train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

base_model = EfficientNetB0(weights="imagenet", include_top=False, pooling="avg")
inp = tf.keras.Input(shape=(224,224,3))
x = preprocess_input(inp)
out = base_model(x)
img_model = Model(inp, out)

def extract_features(img_path):
    try:
        img = Image.open(f"data/{img_path}").convert("RGB")
        img = img.resize((224,224))
        arr = np.expand_dims(np.array(img),0)
        return img_model.predict(arr, verbose=0)[0]
    except Exception:
        return np.zeros((img_model.output_shape[-1],))

train_imgs = np.vstack(train["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)
test_imgs  = np.vstack(test["image_path"].apply(extract_features).values)

# Handle possible target naming differences in the provided dataset
candidate_targets = ["Dry_Green_g","Dry_Dead_g","Dry_Clover_g","GDM_g","Dry_Total_g"]
available_targets = [c for c in candidate_targets if c in train.columns]

if len(available_targets) == 0:
    # Fallback: use submission_format target names if present, else infer numeric non-feature columns
    if os.path.exists("data/submission_format.csv"):
        sf = pd.read_csv("data/submission_format.csv")
        if "target_name" in sf.columns:
            available_targets = sf["target_name"].dropna().unique().tolist()
    if len(available_targets) == 0:
        feature_exclusions = {"sample_id", "image_path", "State", "Species", "Height_Ave_cm", "Pre_GSHH_NDVI"}
        available_targets = [
            c for c in train.columns
            if c not in feature_exclusions and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(train[c])
        ]

targets = train[available_targets].copy()
train = train.drop(columns=available_targets, errors="ignore")

num_cols = [c for c in ["Height_Ave_cm","Pre_GSHH_NDVI"] if c in train.columns and c in test.columns]

# Build tabular features robustly even if some numeric columns are absent
if len(num_cols) > 0:
    X_train = np.hstack([train_imgs, train[num_cols].to_numpy()])
    X_test  = np.hstack([test_imgs, test[num_cols].to_numpy()])
else:
    X_train = train_imgs
    X_test = test_imgs

X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(X_train, targets.values, test_size=0.15, random_state=42)

preds = {}
for i, col in enumerate(targets.columns):
    model = GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:, i])
    vpred = model.predict(X_val)
    print(f"{col} R2:", r2_score(y_val[:, i], vpred))
    preds[col] = model

submission = pd.DataFrame({"sample_id": test["sample_id"]})

for col, model in preds.items():
    submission[col] = model.fit(X_train, targets[col].values).predict(X_test)

sub_long = submission.melt(id_vars="sample_id", var_name="target_name", value_name="target")
sub_long.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

print("✅ submission.csv created")
submission.head()
